name: Metaballs
description: Blobs on lissajous paths melting into each other, sphere-traced so they occlude and pass in front of one another, with the contour banding read off the surface. The camera orbits inside the cluster's reach, so the mass fills the frame.

spread.description: How far the blobs wander from the centre. Wide enough that some of them leave the frame.

goo.description: Smooth-union radius — how far apart two blobs still reach for each other.

distance.description: Camera distance. Below ~3 the near blobs overrun the frame.

bands.description: Palette contour steps. 0 is a smooth ramp; low values are the copper-list look.

glass.description: How much of the backdrop refracts through the blob edges.

bleed.description: Glow around the mass, gathered from rays that nearly grazed it.
